title: The 10 Best-Selling Trucks of 2026 (And What the Ranking Hides)
description:
The ten best-selling pickup trucks in America sold more than two million, one hundred eighty-seven thousand units in nine months. One of them is up forty percent. One is down thirteen percent in its heavy-duty version. And number two is closing in on number one faster than anyone expected. This is the real ranking of the best-selling trucks of twenty twenty-six, and what the ranking hides.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
2:05 10. Ford Ranger
3:09 9. Nissan Frontier
4:14 8. Chevrolet Colorado
5:18 7. Toyota Tundra
6:19 6. Ford Maverick
7:24 5. Toyota Tacoma
8:27 4. GMC Sierra
9:28 3. Ram
10:37 2. Chevrolet Silverado
11:42 1. Ford F-Series
15:57 What the ranking hides
20:57 What to check before you buy in 2027

Sources:
Before the countdown, one number sets the scale. The ten trucks on this list add up to two million, one hundred eighty-seven thousand, seven hundred fifty. The top three alone, the Ford F-Series, the Chevrolet Silverado and the Ram, are fifty-nine percent of that. So the market is concentrated at the top. But the ranking is not frozen, and the changes happen in the middle. Every number comes from a published source, listed in the description.
